summary: First iteration end-to-end testing of ARRAZZAQ Invoice Management System. 24/24 backend pytests passed covering auth, users CRUD, clients CRUD, exchange rates, invoice creation (multi-currency subtotal computation, invoice number generation INV/KFS/2026/06/NNN, sequence increment), PDF generation/download, company settings, dashboard, and RBAC (staff blocked from users/settings/rates endpoints). Frontend smoke-tested via Playwright: admin login -> dashboard with KPI cards, sidebar navigation (all 6 nav-* testids present), client creation, invoice list + invoice view (all required columns NO/DESCRIPTION/RANK/DATE/QTY/PRICE/AMOUNT plus bank info BRINIDJAXXX & account 044102000096506 visible), invoice form (all expected testids present), and logout. Staff RBAC verified in UI: admin-only sidebar items hidden, direct URLs /users /settings /exchange-rates redirect to /dashboard, edit/delete action buttons not shown on invoice rows.

issues: Date inputs use native browser <input type=date> picker (mm/dd/yyyy in en-US) instead of a styled shadcn Calendar. Functional but inconsistent with the rest of the navy/amber design system. Same applies to Item DATE column which is a free-text 'DD/MM/YYYY' input. Consider consolidating on shadcn DatePicker for consistency.

React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. This is caused by Emergent VE wrapper injecting an x-excluded <span> inside <option> elements (option value=clients map). It's a VE artifact, not a product bug, but worth confirming it does not affect the production build.

action_items: No blocking issues. Optional polish: replace native HTML date inputs in InvoiceForm with shadcn DatePicker for visual consistency.
Verify the Emergent VE <span>-in-<option> hydration warning is absent in production build (cosmetic console noise only).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~700 lines and mixes all domain routes; consider splitting into routers per resource (users, clients, invoices, settings, dashboard) for maintainability.
Login endpoint returns the same 401 for unknown user vs inactive user vs wrong password (good for security). is_active=False users get 401 'Invalid credentials' which is fine.

_get_rate_to() in server.py has a confusing snapshot semantic comment versus implementation (comment says 1 unit = snapshot[currency] units of total_currency, implementation does from/to with snapshot values — works correctly only because total_currency is forced to 1.0 before lookup). Worth adding a unit test for SGD->USD via snapshot to lock this in.
Invoice list endpoint returns all invoices (sort by created_at desc) with no pagination — fine for now, but will need limit/offset once volume grows.
PUT /invoices/{id} requires admin (require_admin) which matches RBAC spec (staff cannot edit/delete invoices).
Frontend uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL consistently (verified in lib/api.js).

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (login, dashboard KPIs, all 6 nav links, client creation, invoice list+view fields, invoice form testids, logout, staff RBAC redirects)

test_credentials: admin/admin123 (admin). Created during testing: uistaff/Staff123! (staff, used for RBAC UI verification) and several teststaff_<uuid> users created by pytest.
seed_data_creation: Pytest created: 2 extra invoices INV/KFS/2026/06/002 and INV/KFS/2026/06/003 (June 15 & 20, 2026, USD totals $456.21 and $10.00), 1+ TEST clients (TEST Client xxx, TEST Khalid Faraj Shipping or reused KFS), and one UI staff user 'uistaff' plus pytest staff users 'teststaff_<6hex>'. Exchange rate USD->IDR was updated to 16700 during the test. Company settings phone was set to '+62-21-TEST'. Main agent may want to reset rate to 16500 and clear phone if a clean demo state is desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid (24/24 pytest pass) and exposes all required endpoints with proper RBAC. /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py is the canonical regression suite — run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Frontend testids match the spec. Date pickers are native HTML date inputs (intentional per current implementation, not shadcn Calendar). Staff UI RBAC fully verified. PDF download is implemented as <a href='/api/invoices/{id}/pdf'> link with download attribute — for Playwright, use expect_download() via async context manager (page.expect_download() as dl_info: await click; dl = await dl_info.value) instead of bare expect_download() coroutine.
rca of the issue: No bugs found — first iteration passes all functional acceptance tests defined in the review request.
